now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#26
now.text: Debra Whitman, an ESU science student, becomes Dr. Connors's assistant at his new neogenics lab.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
proposed.text: Debra Whitman, an ESU science student, works in Dr. Connors's lab alongside Peter.

changes.evidence: Debra is already working in Connors's ESU lab in the first episode, 'Night of the Lizard' (#1): she and Peter put on lab coats there, she mistakes the Lizard's voice for Connors, and afterward she wonders why it took Connors. The wiki calls her Connors's intern from the start. #26 ('Shriek of the Vulture') is about Toomes and Norman, and no source places a new start to her work with Connors there.

owner_calls.question: In Runaways S2E3 ('Double Zeros', #13), Darius tricks Alex into a fake run and hands him over to Geoffrey in exchange for the deed to the construction site. Catherine kills Darius in the same episode. Should the kind stay 'ally', or should it become 'enemy' because the stage ends on this betrayal?
options: Keep 'ally' (Darius apologizes and says Alex is safer with his parents)
Change kind to 'enemy' (the stage records Darius selling Alex out)
owner_calls.evidence: Darius lies to Alex about a run, takes him to a warehouse where Geoffrey waits, blocks him from running, apologizes ('just the way it had to be') and takes the deed as payment. Catherine then kills Darius at the Gordon Hotel.

owner_calls.question: Hercules and Thor never meet on screen. Thor names Hercules as a possible recruit, and in the mid-credits scene Zeus sends Hercules to kill Thor. Does this tie stay as it is (an implied tie, and the brief says to keep it), or do you want it treated as knowing ABOUT someone?
owner_calls.evidence: Thor: 'We could recruit Ra, Hercules, Tumatauenga...'. Mid-credits: Zeus tells Hercules to bring Thor down and Hercules says 'Yes, father.' The stage text is accurate.
